wear_types.name: Flank Wear
wear_types.description: Uniform wear band on the relief face from abrasion. The expected, predictable form of wear.

wear_types.name: Crater Wear
wear_types.description: A cavity worn into the rake face behind the edge by chip flow and diffusion at high temperature.

wear_types.name: Built-Up Edge (BUE)
wear_types.description: Work material welds onto the cutting edge, then breaks away taking tool material and ruining finish.

wear_types.name: Notching
wear_types.description: Localized wear at the depth-of-cut line, common in stainless and superalloys due to work hardening.

wear_types.name: Chipping
wear_types.description: Small fractures of the cutting edge rather than gradual wear, leaving a serrated edge.

wear_types.name: Thermal Cracking
wear_types.description: Comb-shaped cracks perpendicular to the edge caused by cyclic heating/cooling.
solutions: Use coolant consistently or run dry

wear_types.name: Edge Fracture
wear_types.description: Gross breakage of the insert from overload — the most catastrophic failure mode.

wear_types.name: Abrasive Wear
wear_types.description: General rounding of the edge from hard inclusions/particles in the workpiece.
